decision_rationale: Methodology verified. The entity-level cluster bootstrap preserves clustering and paired differences; false-alarm denominators (48, 42, 80, 864) are mathematically reconciled; episode detection enforces post-failure exclusion; and 196,507 untouched telemetry entities (including 394 failure entities) are confirmed available in raw shards for Phase 5 confirmatory testing. The existing test set is reclassified as an exploratory development benchmark.

bootstrap_audit.unit_of_resampling: entity_id (clusters all sequential windows and episodes)
bootstrap_audit.duplicate_draw_handling: Each drawn entity instance contributes full window history and failure episodes independently

window_macro_f1.interpretation: Random Forest is significantly superior to Temporal LSTM on window-level macro-F1.

window_accuracy.interpretation: Random Forest is significantly superior on window-level classification accuracy.

warning_recall.interpretation: Temporal LSTM is significantly superior on Warning class recall (early failure anticipation).

critical_recall.interpretation: RF has higher sample critical recall, but paired difference is not statistically significant at 0.05 level (CI upper bound crosses 0).

episode_detection_rate_pct.interpretation: Temporal LSTM has a higher point estimate (+5.75%), but the difference is NOT statistically significant because the 95% CI spans zero [-9.69%, +21.06%].

pure_normal_far_pct.interpretation: Temporal LSTM point FAR is lower, but paired difference touches zero.

pure_normal_far_test.eligibility: Test entities with zero failure events across the entire observation trace

pure_normal_far_validation.eligibility: Validation entities with zero failure events across the entire trace (78 total - 36 failing)

all_entity_normal_period_far_test.eligibility: All 80 test entities evaluated strictly during normal operating windows (label == 0, t_pred < T_fail - 30m)
all_entity_normal_period_far_test.alert_definition: Any window with predicted_label in {1, 2} during normal period

window_fpr_test.eligibility: All test sliding windows with ground-truth label == 0

reconciliation_of_denominators.denom_48: 48 pure-normal entities in test partition (80 total entities - 32 failing entities)
reconciliation_of_denominators.denom_42: 42 pure-normal entities in validation partition (78 total entities - 36 failing entities)
reconciliation_of_denominators.denom_80: 80 total entities in test partition evaluated during normal operating windows
reconciliation_of_denominators.denom_864: 864 total ground-truth normal windows across all 80 test entities

episode_detection_lead_time_audit.operational_rule_consistency: Identical: first qualifying alert where predicted_label in {1, 2} and t_pred < T_fail
episode_detection_lead_time_audit.deployable_hybrid_distinction: Oracle union (77.8%) reflects theoretical upper bound of complementary coverage, not deployable performance. Deployable hybrid requires trained online gating.

confirmatory_data_feasibility.recommendation: Reserve 100 unused failing entities and 200 unused normal entities from sample_task_usage.csv.gz as untouched Confirmatory Test Set (Phase 5). For external validity, cross-validate on Alibaba Cluster Trace 2018/2021.
